content: <thought>Using the list of available functional groups, the DIBAL‑H reduction corresponds to breaking a “carboxylic esters” group and forming an “aldehydes” group (the carbonyl bond order changes from double to single, yielding an aliphatic hydroxyl after further work‑up).
